name: intent_unclear
description: Call this instead of answering in text when the request is: ambiguous (could mean several different actions), off_topic (not about controlling this Mac), incomplete (no target named, such as 'turn it on'), or unsupported (refers to something this Mac control set cannot do). Pass one of: ambiguous, off_topic, incomplete, unsupported.
script: return "unclear: {reason}"

name: list_events
description: List calendar events for a given day.
script:
set d to (current date)
set year of d to {day_y}
set month of d to {day_mo}
set day of d to {day_d}
set time of d to 0
set e to d + (1 * days)
tell application "Calendar"
  set out to ""
  repeat with c in calendars
    repeat with ev in (every event of c whose start date is greater than or equal to d and start date is less than e)
      set out to out & (summary of ev) & " at " & (time string of (start date of ev)) & linefeed
    end repeat
  end repeat
end tell
if out is "" then return "no events"
return out

name: create_event
description: Create a calendar event at a given date and time. Default length is one hour.

name: next_event
description: Report the next upcoming calendar event.
script:
set n to current date
set horizon to n + (14 * days)
tell application "Calendar"
  set best to missing value
  repeat with c in calendars
    repeat with ev in (every event of c whose start date is greater than n and start date is less than horizon)
      if best is missing value or (start date of ev) < (start date of best) then set best to ev
    end repeat
  end repeat
  if best is missing value then return "nothing in the next two weeks"
  return (summary of best) & " at " & ((start date of best) as text)
end tell

name: delete_event
description: Delete a calendar event by title on a given day. DESTRUCTIVE.
script:
set d to (current date)
set year of d to {day_y}
set month of d to {day_mo}
set day of d to {day_d}
set time of d to 0
set e to d + (1 * days)
tell application "Calendar"
  set n to 0
  repeat with c in calendars
    repeat with ev in (every event of c whose start date is greater than or equal to d and start date is less than e and summary contains "{title}")
      delete ev
      set n to n + 1
    end repeat
  end repeat
end tell
return "deleted " & n

name: send_email
description: Compose and send an email to one recipient.

name: unread_count
description: Report how many unread messages are in the inbox.
script:
tell application "Mail"
  check for new mail
  return (count of (messages of inbox whose read status is false)) as text
end tell

name: list_recent_mail
description: List the most recent messages in the inbox, newest first.
script:
tell application "Mail"
  set out to ""
  set msgs to messages of inbox
  set n to {limit}
  if n > (count of msgs) then set n to count of msgs
  repeat with i from 1 to n
    set m to item i of msgs
    set out to out & (sender of m) & " — " & (subject of m) & linefeed
  end repeat
  if out is "" then return "inbox is empty"
  return out
end tell

name: search_mail
description: Search the inbox for messages whose subject contains the given text.
script:
tell application "Mail"
  set out to ""
  set found to (messages of inbox whose subject contains "{query}")
  set n to {limit}
  if n > (count of found) then set n to count of found
  repeat with i from 1 to n
    set m to item i of found
    set out to out & (sender of m) & " — " & (subject of m) & linefeed
  end repeat
  if out is "" then return "no matches"
  return out
end tell

name: find_file
description: Find files by name anywhere in the home folder. Give a plain word or extension such as invoice or pdf, never a wildcard pattern.
script: do shell script "mdfind -onlyin ~ -name '{name}' | head -{limit}"

name: open_file
description: Open a file or folder in its default application.
script:
do shell script "open '{path}'"
return "opened"

name: recent_files
description: List files in the home folder changed most recently.
script: do shell script "find ~ -type f -not -path '*/.*' -mtime -2 -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 ls -lt 2>/dev/null | head -{limit} | awk '{print $NF}'"

name: large_files
description: List the largest files in the home folder, biggest first.
script: do shell script "mdfind -onlyin ~ 'kMDItemFSSize > 200000000' 2>/dev/null | head -{limit} | while read f; do du -h \"$f\" 2>/dev/null; done | sort -rh"

name: disk_free
description: Report free disk space on the startup volume.
script: do shell script "df -h / | tail -1 | awk '{print $4 \" free of \" $2}'"

name: move_file
description: Move a file to another folder. DESTRUCTIVE.
script:
do shell script "mv '{path}' '{dest}'"
return "moved"

name: trash_file
description: Move a file to the Trash. DESTRUCTIVE.
script:
tell application "Finder" to delete POSIX file "{path}"
return "trashed"

name: empty_trash
description: Empty the Trash permanently. DESTRUCTIVE.
script:
tell application "Finder" to empty trash
return "emptied"

name: create_note
description: Create a note with a title and body.
script:
tell application "Notes"
  tell account 1
    make new note with properties {name:"{title}", body:"{body}"}
  end tell
end tell
return "created"

name: search_notes
description: Find notes whose title contains the given text.
script:
tell application "Notes"
  set out to ""
  repeat with n in (notes of account 1 whose name contains "{query}")
    set out to out & (name of n) & linefeed
  end repeat
  if out is "" then return "no matching notes"
  return out
end tell

name: read_note
description: Read the contents of a note by title.
script:
tell application "Notes"
  set matches to (notes of account 1 whose name contains "{title}")
  if (count of matches) is 0 then return "no such note"
  return plaintext of item 1 of matches
end tell

name: create_reminder
description: Create a reminder, optionally due at a date and time.

name: list_reminders
description: List reminders that are not yet completed.
script:
tell application "Reminders"
  set out to ""
  repeat with r in (reminders whose completed is false)
    set out to out & (name of r) & linefeed
  end repeat
  if out is "" then return "nothing outstanding"
  return out
end tell

name: complete_reminder
description: Mark a reminder as completed by title.
script:
tell application "Reminders"
  set matches to (reminders whose completed is false and name contains "{title}")
  if (count of matches) is 0 then return "no such reminder"
  set completed of item 1 of matches to true
end tell
return "completed"

name: battery_status
description: Report battery percentage and whether the Mac is charging.
script: do shell script "pmset -g batt | tail -1 | awk -F'; ' '{print $1 \" \" $2}' | sed 's/^.*\t//'"

name: set_volume
description: Set the system output volume, 0 to 100.
script:
set volume output volume {level}
return "volume {level}"

name: mute_audio
description: Mute or unmute system audio.
script:
if "{state}" is "on" or "{state}" is "true" or "{state}" is "mute" then
  set volume with output muted
  return "muted"
else
  set volume without output muted
  return "unmuted"
end if

name: set_dark_mode
description: Turn dark mode on or off.
script:
tell application "System Events"
  tell appearance preferences
    if "{state}" is "on" or "{state}" is "true" or "{state}" is "dark" then
      set dark mode to true
    else
      set dark mode to false
    end if
    return "dark mode " & (dark mode as text)
  end tell
end tell

name: lock_screen
description: Lock the screen immediately.
script:
do shell script "pmset displaysleepnow"
return "locked"

name: top_processes
description: List the processes using the most CPU right now.
script: do shell script "ps -Arco pid,pcpu,comm | head -{limit}"

name: memory_pressure
description: Report free memory and swap use, for when the Mac feels slow.
script: do shell script "vm_stat | head -4; sysctl -n vm.swapusage"

name: wifi_status
description: Report which wifi network the Mac is on.
script: do shell script "networksetup -getairportnetwork en0"

name: current_datetime
description: Report the current date and time.
script: return (current date) as text
